summary:
All 12 acceptance criteria are met on this PC: Windows 11 Pro 26200, not elevated, luafv Running, DisableLastAccess=2. The Windows 10 measurement (C3) is person-run.

**Test runs**
- Full suite: 804/804 passed under TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP.
- LastAccessUnderSystemRootTests passed 6/6 under the engine's TEMP and again under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp. In each run:
  - the three Windows\Temp lines read 'kept 4 of 7 ... moved: <root>, plain, links';
  - the new %ProgramData% line read 'C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests\<guid>: kept 7 of 7; 7 of 7 ... moved: none';
  - the %LOCALAPPDATA% line read 'kept 7 of 7 ... moved: none'.
- The new Fact alone passed 3 runs in a row.
- C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests held 0 entries before and after every run.

**Mutation and rules**
- I widened Scanner.cs:340 to `if (false)`. The new Fact went red with 'kept 4 of 7 ... a correction fired outside %SystemRoot%'.
- I restored the file. Its hash matched the original, git showed no change, and the class was green again.
- Fitness op=check: 87 rules, every declared rule holds.
- rules-parity: AGREE (18 facts, 22 twinned, 48 patterns) under both pwsh and powershell.exe.
- The single-file publish succeeded, and its --report run read through read-window.ps1 exited 0.

**My own measurement of existing folders**
I opened existing folders directly, not through the project's code:
- %ProgramData%, scanner mask 0x101: 4 parents with last access 12.8 h old (Adobe←ARM, Affinity←Photo, Affinity\Photo←2.0, Oracle←Java). 0 moved.
- C:\Windows positive control: 4 parents (System32\com←dmp, SysWOW64\com←dmp, Registration←CRMLog, spool\drivers←color). All 4 moved on a write-class open. 0x101 was refused there (error 5), so the control used 0x2. Read-class opens moved none.

**Create refusal (Q-210)**
A tests root refused by its access list (a deny CreateDirectories rule on a folder in my own temp) became the named InvalidOperationException 'Could not create …', with the UnauthorizedAccessException kept inside. That is the case the slice's own test does not feed (backlog SC-185).

**%ProgramFiles% not re-measured**
- Their parents' last-access times were only 0.60 h old, so a move would not show.
- The verdict stands on the survey's and investigation's measurements, which the SL-097 doc and the ScanResult remark record.

**Other**
- The record now says what was measured where the tree said 'unmeasured'. The re-scan gap from spike #3 is reported as measured, and 'falsified' appears nowhere.
- The slice has one build attempt; nothing was sent back in a loop.

criteria.criterion: 1. Count kept folders in a scan of a fresh nested 7-folder %ProgramData% tree under <CommonApplicationData>\fsa-tests\<guid>, back-dated 48 h
criteria.how: Ran 6 times today (2 class runs, 3 single runs, plus the full suite). Each time: asked 7, 'kept 7 of 7; 7 of 7 folders still at least 47 h old; moved: none', under C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests\<guid>.

criteria.criterion: 2. Read the %ProgramData% result as a no-move measurement beside the same invocation's Windows\Temp positive and %LOCALAPPDATA% negative controls
criteria.how: In the same class invocation, Windows\Temp read 'moved: <root>, plain, links' for all 3 spellings, %ProgramData% read 'moved: none' and %LOCALAPPDATA% read 'moved: none'. My own existing-folder probe agrees: C:\Windows 4 of 4 parents moved, %ProgramData% 0 of 4.

criteria.criterion: 3. Same result whether the suite inherits TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP or TEMP=%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp
criteria.how: The class ran under both values, exit 0 with the same lines. The Fact's root comes from GetFolderPath(CommonApplicationData) = C:\ProgramData either way.

criteria.criterion: 4. Three runs in a row on a live machine
criteria.how: The single-Fact filter ran 3 times in a row, exit 0, 'kept 7 of 7 ... moved: none' each time. No red.

criteria.criterion: 5. Clean up after the %ProgramData% Fact in a machine-wide tests root
criteria.how: C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests held 0 entries before the full suite and after every run, including the mutant run. The empty fsa-tests parent stays, as designed.

criteria.criterion: 6. State the measured limit where the tree said 'unmeasured' (ScanResult remark and SL-096 limits)
criteria.how: Both 'unmeasured and not corrected' sentences are replaced. They cite SL-097, Windows 10 and elevated scans as unmeasured, and the existing re-scan gap sentences are kept. TheMeasuredLastAccessLimitIsWrittenWhereTheTreeSaidUnmeasured passed in the 804/804 run.

criteria.criterion: 7. Architecture rules and the full suite stay green beside the new Fact and the new comment text
criteria.how: Full suite 804/804. Fitness op=check: 87 rules, every declared rule holds. rules-parity AGREEs under pwsh and powershell.exe.

criteria.criterion: 8. Guard against widening the correction at Scanner.cs:340
criteria.how: With the line's condition replaced by false, the new Fact went red with 'kept 4 of 7 ... a correction fired outside %SystemRoot%'. Restored byte-identical and green again.

criteria.criterion: 9. Resolve the %ProgramData% tests root when CommonApplicationData is blank, not fully qualified, or at or under the Windows folder
criteria.how: The TempTreeRootTests rows for blank, whitespace, relative, drive-relative, three under-Windows spellings and an untellable Windows folder passed in the full suite. In this engine shell the known folder resolves to C:\ProgramData.

criteria.criterion: 10. Create the %ProgramData% tests root when CreateDirectory is refused by its ACL
criteria.how: Live check through the real TempTree.CreateRoot, loaded by reflection, on a folder in my own temp that denies CreateDirectories. It threw the named InvalidOperationException 'Could not create ... never skipped ...' with the UnauthorizedAccessException inside. No suite test feeds this shape; that is backlog SC-185.

criteria.criterion: 11. Count kept folders in %ProgramFiles% and %ProgramFiles(x86)% for a folder a standard user can write-open
criteria.how:
As the design fixed it, there is no fixture and the verdict is recorded from the existing-folder measurements. The record is written:
- SL-097 doc table: %ProgramFiles(x86)% 0 of 21 (investigation) and 0 of 20 (survey); %ProgramFiles% 0 of 1; the ACL walk found 1 write-grantable folder of 10,442.
- ScanResult remark.
My own re-measure could not run: the parents' last access was 0.60 h old. So the numbers rest on the earlier stages' measurements from today, not on mine.

criteria.criterion: 12. Re-scan of the same C:\Windows\Temp tree within minutes, with or without re-back-dating
criteria.how:
As designed, no re-scan test. The SL-097 doc reports spike #3 as measured:
- the re-back-dated re-scans moved again with kept equal to the truth;
- the +30 s un-back-dated re-scan moved nothing yet counted 3 out, which is the existing gap.
ScanResult and SL-096 :91-92 keep that gap, and 'falsified' is absent.

criteria.criterion: C3 (title): the parent move measured the same way on Windows 10
criteria.how:
On a Windows 10 PC, with luafv running and last-access updates on, as a non-elevated user, from the repository root, run:
pwsh -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File eng/dotnet.ps1 test tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~LastAccessUnderSystemRootTests|FullyQualifiedName~LastAccessTests|FullyQualifiedName~HeldOpenTreeTests" --logger "console;verbosity=detailed"

Report every 'moved:' line. Matching Windows 11 means:
- the Windows\Temp lines read 'moved: <root>, plain, links';
- the %ProgramData% and %LOCALAPPDATA% lines read 'moved: none';
- all tests are green.
A red %ProgramData% line means the scanner over-counts there. A red Windows\Temp line is Q-210's intended signal.

obligations.evidence:
No rule fires on the new Fact or the reworded remark:
- Fitness op=check over this working tree: '87 rule(s) checked ... Every declared rule holds.'
- eng/rules-parity.ps1: AGREE (18 facts, 22 twinned, 48 patterns), exit 0, under pwsh and powershell.exe.
- The full suite, including LastAccessRuleCorpusTests' reflection guard, passed 804/804.

In the engine's agent shell (pwsh, TEMP=C:\WINDOWS\TEMP, not elevated), [Environment]::GetFolderPath('CommonApplicationData') returned C:\ProgramData, which is fully qualified. The test host it started created and removed C:\ProgramData\fsa-tests\<guid> in each of the 6 runs.

not_reached: Windows 10, in every location: no Windows 10 machine here. The Sandbox (Windows 11 26100, EnableLUA=0) blocks luafv (error 1275). Person-run: the command is in the SL-097 doc.

An elevated scan with luafv loaded in %ProgramData% and %ProgramFiles%: it needs a session running the project's code as an administrator, which neither named operation provides. Not needed while the app never runs elevated and LastAccessKept is internal (Q-159).

My own fresh re-measure of %ProgramFiles% and %ProgramFiles(x86)%: every candidate parent's last access was 0.60 h old, under NTFS's 1-hour rule, so nothing was opened. Their verdict rests on the survey's and investigation's measurements from earlier today.

A same-mask positive control on existing C:\Windows folders: the scanner's 0x101 was refused there (error 5), so my control used 0x2 while the %ProgramData% probes used 0x101. The same-mask 0x101 move under C:\Windows\Temp comes from the project's own Fact runs.
Stability of the %ProgramData% Fact against Defender or the indexer over days or weeks: only about 9 clean runs today on one machine.
A machine where C:\ProgramData itself refuses folder creation by this user: only simulated with a deny rule on a folder in my own temp.
